products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare sector. The company offers a portfolio of products spanning clinical decision support, enterprise imaging, clinical data management, and real-world evidence. Its clinical decision support tool, Micromedex, is positioned for use at the point of care, while Zelta is a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed to support clinical trials. The enterprise imaging suite includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, and Merge Workflow Orchestrator, and Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo are described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked solutions for cardiovascular service lines. Truven provides health data, analytics, and consulting services aimed at supporting business decisions within healthcare organizations.

The company was formerly known as Watson Health, and its AI and analytics work spans clinical AI, population health, and protected health information governance. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the site include a jump from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort, as well as an expectation that identifying fetal toxicities could be reduced from a 10-year timeline to fewer than 5 years through access to large, clean datasets.
